movie.mainStoryPrompt: Silent Minecraft adventure. Steve and Alex inspect an old mountain minecart line. Alex sits in a cart while Steve tests a lever, but the powered rail activates and sends her rolling downhill. Steve jumps into a second cart and follows. They race through a tunnel, reach a broken switch, and Steve flips the lever just in time so both carts take the safe track. The line bursts out into a bright mountain meadow and stops gently against hay bales. No dialogue, no narration, no injury.
movie.storySummary: Steve และ Alex สำรวจรางรถเหมืองบนภูเขา แต่ Alex เผลอถูก powered rail ส่งรถวิ่งลงเนิน Steve กระโดดขึ้นรถอีกคันตามไป ทั้งคู่ผ่านอุโมงค์และสวิตช์รางที่ต้องแก้ทันเวลา ก่อนออกสู่ทุ่งบนภูเขาและหยุดอย่างปลอดภัยที่กอง hay bale

scenes.title: Old Rail Line
scenes.description: Steve and Alex inspect an old minecart track in a mountain.
scenes.location: สถานีรางภูเขา (Mountain Rail Station)
scenes.actionDescription: Steve และ Alex เดินตรวจ powered rail กับ lever ที่สถานีเล็กในภูเขา
scenes.imageDescription: Recognizable Minecraft Steve and Alex beside a minecart track with powered rails, lever and stone mountain entrance, bright daylight outside.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow pan along the rails to Steve and Alex inspecting the lever. Audio: light rail ambience, playful adventure music. No speech.

scenes.title: Test Ride
scenes.description: Alex sits in the first minecart while Steve reaches for the lever.
scenes.location: สถานีรางภูเขา (Mountain Rail Station)
scenes.actionDescription: Alex นั่งลงใน minecart และ Steve วางมือบน lever ข้างราง
scenes.imageDescription: Minecraft Alex seated in a minecart on powered rail, Steve beside a lever, mountain tunnel ahead, bright safe setting.
scenes.videoPrompt: Medium side shot as Alex settles in the cart and Steve reaches the lever. Audio: cart clink, playful music. No speech.

scenes.title: Powered Rail
scenes.description: The lever activates and Alex's minecart rolls away faster than expected.
scenes.location: สถานีรางภูเขา (Mountain Rail Station)
scenes.actionDescription: Steve โยก lever และรถของ Alex พุ่งออกจากสถานีไปตามรางลงเนิน
scenes.imageDescription: Minecraft powered rails glowing as Alex's minecart starts rolling quickly into the mountain tunnel, Steve surprised beside the lever.
scenes.videoPrompt: Quick tracking move with Alex's cart leaving the station. Audio: lever click, powered rail hum, cart wheels accelerate, music jumps faster. No speech.

scenes.title: Steve Follows
scenes.description: Steve jumps into a second minecart and follows Alex.
scenes.location: อุโมงค์รางเหมือง (Minecart Tunnel)
scenes.actionDescription: Steve กระโดดลง minecart คันที่สองและรถเริ่มวิ่งตาม Alex
scenes.imageDescription: Recognizable Minecraft Steve dropping into a second minecart on glowing powered rails, Alex's cart visible farther ahead in the tunnel.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear tracking shot behind Steve's cart accelerating after Alex. Audio: minecart wheels, rail clacks, fast upbeat music. No speech.

scenes.title: Tunnel Race
scenes.description: Both carts race through a bright torch-lit tunnel.
scenes.location: อุโมงค์รางเหมือง (Minecart Tunnel)
scenes.actionDescription: minecart สองคันวิ่งตามกันผ่านอุโมงค์ที่มี torch เรียงตามผนัง
scenes.imageDescription: Two Minecraft minecarts with Alex ahead and Steve behind racing through a clean torch-lit stone tunnel, red powered rails glowing.
scenes.videoPrompt: Fast forward tracking shot centered between the two carts. Audio: rhythmic rail clacks, tunnel echoes, energetic music. No speech.

scenes.title: Broken Switch
scenes.description: They approach a track junction set toward an unfinished branch.
scenes.location: ทางแยกราง (Rail Junction)
scenes.actionDescription: Alex เห็นทางแยกรางข้างหน้าที่ชี้ไปยังรางซึ่งยังสร้างไม่เสร็จ
scenes.imageDescription: Minecraft rail junction ahead of Alex's minecart, one safe track and one visibly unfinished short branch, lever beside the junction, bright torches.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low push toward the upcoming junction from Alex's cart. Audio: warning musical pulse, fast wheels. No speech.

scenes.title: Flip the Lever
scenes.description: Steve reaches the junction lever and flips it in time.
scenes.location: ทางแยกราง (Rail Junction)
scenes.actionDescription: Steve ยื่นมือจากรถและโยก lever ก่อนรถทั้งสองถึงทางแยก
scenes.imageDescription: Recognizable Minecraft Steve leaning from his minecart to flip a track lever while Alex's cart approaches the junction ahead, one coherent action.
scenes.videoPrompt: Side tracking shot as Steve flips the lever once and the rail switch changes to the safe route. Audio: lever click, rail switch clack, music peak. No speech.

scenes.title: Into the Sun
scenes.description: The carts burst out of the tunnel into a sunny mountain meadow.
scenes.location: ทุ่งบนภูเขา (Mountain Meadow)
scenes.actionDescription: minecart ทั้งสองออกจากอุโมงค์สู่ทุ่งหญ้าบนภูเขาที่มีแสงแดดจ้า
scenes.imageDescription: Minecraft minecart track emerging from a stone mountain into a bright flower meadow, Alex and Steve riding out under blue sky.
scenes.videoPrompt: Forward tracking shot from tunnel darkness into bright meadow light with both carts. Audio: wind opens up, birds, music becomes triumphant. No speech.

scenes.title: Hay Bale Stop
scenes.description: The carts gently stop against a hay-bale buffer.
scenes.location: ทุ่งบนภูเขา (Mountain Meadow)
scenes.actionDescription: minecart ทั้งสองชะลอและชนกอง hay bale เบา ๆ จนหยุด
scenes.imageDescription: Two Minecraft minecarts gently stopped at a stack of hay bales in a sunny mountain meadow, Steve and Alex safe and surprised.
scenes.videoPrompt: Static medium shot as both carts roll slowly into the hay-bale buffer and stop. Audio: soft hay thump, cart squeak, playful music accent. No speech.

scenes.title: Push Them Back
scenes.description: Steve and Alex push the minecarts back toward the station together.
scenes.location: ทุ่งบนภูเขา (Mountain Meadow)
scenes.actionDescription: Steve และ Alex ช่วยกันเข็น minecart กลับขึ้นรางท่ามกลางทุ่งดอกไม้
scenes.imageDescription: Minecraft Steve and Alex smiling silently as they push two minecarts along track through a bright mountain meadow, sunset beginning behind peaks.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow pull-back as they push the carts together toward the tunnel. Audio: gentle rail squeaks, warm music ending, meadow breeze. Fade out. No speech.
